definitions.name: G0B.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 when empty)

definitions.name: G0B.MEAN
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0B.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

definitions.name: G0B.MOD
definitions.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a mod b (floor remainder)

definitions.name: G0B.ABS
definitions.body: 'AD' BIND AD AD -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value of a scalar or element-wise of a Vector

definitions.name: G0B.COUNT
definitions.body: NOT [ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: number of TRUE lanes in a Vector of truths

definitions.name: G0B.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: index of the first largest element of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: G0B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES G0B.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record of key->number: the key with the largest value, first on ties

definitions.name: G0B.MODEOF
definitions.body: TALLY G0B.TOPKEY
definitions.note: most frequent element of a Vector, first-appearing on ties

definitions.name: G0B.FIRSTS
definitions.body: [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: first element of each row of a Vector of Vectors

definitions.name: G0B.SECONDS
definitions.body: [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: second element of each row of a Vector of Vectors

definitions.name: G0B.GROUPSUM
definitions.body: GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ G0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys-vector values-vector -> Record key -> sum of its values, first-appearance order

definitions.name: G0B.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'BL' BIND BL G0B.FIRSTS BL G0B.SECONDS G0B.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [key amount] rows -> Record key -> summed amount

definitions.name: G0B.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE 'DK' BIND DN DK DIV 'DQ' BIND 0 DK DQ DQ FLOOR SUB 0 GT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending

definitions.name: G0B.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 'BQ' BIND BQ BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR BP BN GT G0B.COUNT DROP JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 as a base-2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: G0B.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CX' BIND 3 CX MUL 1 ADD CX 2 DIV CX 2 G0B.MOD 0 GT SELECT 'CY' BIND 1 CY CX 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: one Collatz step, with 1 staying at 1

definitions.name: G0B.WORDS
definitions.body: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 0 GT ] FILTER
definitions.note: String -> lower-case words split on spaces, empty pieces dropped

definitions.name: G0B.SPACED
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

definitions.name: G0B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

definitions.name: G0B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: G0B.DEV
definitions.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV G0B.MEAN SUB
definitions.note: each number minus the mean

definitions.name: G0B.VAR
definitions.body: G0B.DEV 'DD' BIND DD DD MUL G0B.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance

definitions.name: G0B.MAXOF
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: G0B.ORDVAL
definitions.body: 'OO' BIND OO 'price' GET 'OP' BIND 0 OP OP NIL? SELECT OO 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: G0B.REVENUE
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ G0B.ORDVAL ] MAP G0B.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: G0B.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'OL' BIND OL [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OL [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0B.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty

solutions.ledger.debtors: G0B.BYNAME 'RR' BIND RR KEYS RR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'XL' BIND XL XL G0B.SECONDS G0B.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0B.WORDS [ G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.number.primes: 'NN' BIND 1 NN RANGE [ G0B.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.collatz: 'CN' BIND 1 120 RANGE CN [ 0 MUL ADD G0B.CSTEP ] SCAN 1 GT G0B.COUNT 1 0 CN 1 GT SELECT ADD
solutions.orders.unpriced: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'MV' BIND MV G0B.MEDIAN 'MM' BIND MV MM SUB G0B.ABS G0B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MV' BIND MV -2 DROP MV 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MV 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'MV' BIND MV MV 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: SORT 'RS' BIND RS -1 GET RS 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'NV' BIND NV SORT 'NS' BIND NS 0 GET 'LO' BIND NS -1 GET 'HI' BIND NV LO SUB HI LO SUB DIV
solutions.text.acronym: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
